intro: A separate reviewer read all 22 pages of the five brief documents (Main Guidelines, Deliverables, Models and Training Guidelines, Dataset Exploration, Assessment and Plagiarism Policy) and checked each of the 179 requirements against the actual files: code, results, figures and the rendered report. It did not rely on the project's own audit files. No requirement needs retraining. The open items are report presentation, wording and provenance, plus the parts only the team can do (public repository, two-laptop demo and screenshots, usernames). After the audit, the report issues it found were fixed and the report rebuilt: readable comparison tables with precision and recall, the metric rationale, model-specific over/under-fitting answers, headings in the brief's numbering, partition-named captions, zoomed Folium maps, EVALUATION-mode UI captures and a provenance note. The statuses below reflect that.
